policy.purpose: Separate technical asset integrity from editorial/source evidence. A local file may be verified technically without implying official provenance.

levels.label: REFERENCE ONLY

policy.externalMediaRule: No external photo, cover, logo or scan is promoted to reusable media unless provenance and reuse status are separately recorded.
